_comment: Deployment roles, the SeisComp3 way: same binaries, a role is just a set of enabled modules plus a few parameters. `terrapulse setup --role <name>` writes etc/enabled.json (site state). Module start arguments are built from these params by etc/init/<module>.py start_args(env). Waveforms are served by an acquisition node's SeedLink backbone and pulled by the processing/centre nodes (backbone_host).

standalone.description: Everything on one machine (demo / development): broker, SeedLink backbone, a simulated source, and the full processing tier.

acquisition.description: Acquisition node next to the sensors (SeisComp3 seedlink node): runs the sensors and its own SeedLink backbone, which the centre pulls from. The lightest build (TP_BUILD_GUI=OFF).

center.description: Object monitoring centre: broker, processing and web services. Pulls waveforms from an acquisition node's SeedLink backbone (backbone_host).

processor.description: Dedicated processing node: reads an acquisition node's backbone and handles one station partition.

playback.description: Replay archived data as if it were live, for tests and presentations.

gui.description: Operator workstation. GUI views are not daemons - run them with `terrapulse exec tprttv|tpmap|tpolv|tpconfig`.
